🔍 4 Issues & Challenges Identified in Review → Turned into Resolved GitHub Issues

GitHub Issue #1 • CLOSED in v1.1.0

Entry-Level Listings Demanding 2+ Years of Production Experience

Issue Found: Looking at raw job descriptions can be discouraging when "Entry-Level" roles list Kubernetes, Spark, or enterprise RAG deployment.
Resolution Deployed: Added the interactive Experience Paradox Decoder & Resume Bullet Generator to every job card.

GitHub Issue #3 • CLOSED in v1.2.0

"AI Engineer" Means Completely Different Stacks

Issue Found: Without sub-tracks, a student can't tell if an "AI Engineer" role requires writing CUDA kernels in C++ or orchestrating multi-agent workflows in Python/TypeScript.
Resolution Deployed: Added visual Stack Weight Bars (SWE/APIs vs. Core ML vs. Infra/MLOps vs. Product/UX) to every role.

GitHub Issue #2 • CLOSED in v1.1.0

Filtering for NYC/NJ Transit Access vs. Relocation

Issue Found: As an NJIT student in Newark, knowing whether a role is accessible via PATH/NJ Transit to NYC or fully U.S.-remote matters immediately.
Resolution Deployed: Added the live NYC/Newark Metro Corridor & U.S.-Remote Commute Filter bar on the Early-Career jobs page.

GitHub Issue #5 • CLOSED in v1.3.0

Comparing Live AI Salaries Against Federal BLS Baselines

Issue Found: Reading 14+ job descriptions in text makes it hard to measure how much each tier pays above federal medians.
Resolution Deployed: Built the interactive AI Role vs. BLS Median Wage Comparator alongside 3 custom data charts.

📦 GitHub Repository & VitePress Deployment Package (v1.4.0)

🚀 Seeing "404 There isn't a GitHub Pages site here"? Fix It in 3 Browser Clicks (No Terminal Needed!):
  1. Click the two buttons below to download index.html and README.md directly to your computer.
  2. On GitHub (github.com/JivExperimenters), open your ai-career-research-atlas repo, click Add file → Upload files, drag index.html and README.md directly into the upload box (do NOT upload a .zip file itself!), and click Commit changes.
  3. In your repo, go to Settings → Pages (left sidebar). Under Build and deployment → Source, select Deploy from a branch, choose branch main and folder / (root), and click Save. Refresh in 30 seconds!
🔧 Why GitHub Pages Deploy Failed & How v1.4.1 Fixes It:
  • Cause 1 (GitHub Actions Crash): cache: npm inside .github/workflows/deploy.yml fails with "Dependencies lock file is not found" when there is no package-lock.json. Fixed: Removed cache: npm and added enablement: true.
  • Cause 2 (Branch Deploy Mode): If GitHub Pages is set to "Deploy from a branch (main / root)" instead of "GitHub Actions", there was no root index.html or .nojekyll. Fixed: Added root index.html + .nojekyll so BOTH Deploy from a branch AND GitHub Actions work!
  • Cause 3 (Repo Name Mismatch): Hardcoded base path broke CSS/JS if your repo name differed in casing. Fixed: Auto-detects process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY and sets ignoreDeadLinks: true.
Option A: Already Pushed Repo? Copy Fixed .github/workflows/deploy.yml 
name: Deploy VitePress site to Pages
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
        with:
          enablement: true
        continue-on-error: true
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - env:
          GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: npm run docs:build
      - run: touch docs/.vitepress/dist/.nojekyll
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: docs/.vitepress/dist
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
Option B: Push Updated v1.4.1 Repo Zip (Works with Branch OR Actions!) 
unzip -o ai-career-research-atlas-repo.zip
cd ai-career-research-atlas
git init
git add .
git commit -m "Release v1.4.1: Fix GitHub Pages deploy.yml + add root index.html fallback"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/JivExperimenters/ai-career-research-atlas.git || true
git push -u origin main --force
